answer: Rotating tri-domain witness rota: each epoch three witnesses are drawn from three independent islands, and any submission needs all three signatures. The rota is seeded by the epoch hash and published in the orchard ledger before the window opens, so a farm cannot forecast its judges. To keep k fakes alive an attacker must corrupt witnesses across islands every epoch; a bribe grows with the witness's reputation and repeats each cycle. Collusion caught on one island cascades slashing down the chain. Honest agents submit once; every fake voyage pays a fresh asking price per epoch.
